text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days before the Arima Kinen,
Mayano Top
Gun asks me to come see
her.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Over here, Trainer! Quick! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! ☆ Look at this snowman!
And look at
that tree over there! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ♪ We're on a special date today,
after all!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Tonight's the most sacred night of the
year for
lovers... Haha. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In fact, it's not even the right day to
begin with...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I know that!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there are still a few days to go.
And sure,
it's not even night, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I thought we should make a promise
while we can!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Of course I wanna go on a date
the night
of, but we've already got plans
for that day.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Take my picture! ☆ With your phone!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Are you ready? Don't let this
photo op go
to waste!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Three, two, one...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Do I look cute? Cherish that
photo, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You'll see me make that same pose when
the
special day arrives. That'll be my
present to you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I check the picture to see what she
means...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the picture, Mayano Top Gun is
proudly
waving into the distance with a
smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! ☆ In other words, I'm going to
win the
Arima!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Your present this year is getting to see
me shine
brighter than ever!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So please spend the special day with me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...At the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her declaration, I become a bit
more
excited for this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the picture, she's blowing a kiss
toward the
camera.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I hope you're looking forward to
the
winning concert after the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll be standing in the center, blowing a
kiss for
you and you alone! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Don't worry about it. ☆ I'll make
sure no
one realizes it's just for you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heehee... It feels like our relationship
just became
more grown-up, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, it's fine! I'll do it stealthily when
the stage
is dark!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Which means... you have to keep your
eyes on me
the whole time throughout
the Arima Kinen
concert! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Or would you rather I kiss you after I
come off the
stage?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't mind that either! Ehehe! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make her promise not to do anything of
the sort.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But still, at this year's Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know Mayano Top Gun will take first
place and
stand center stage for me.
